name: @rawback/cli
description: Rawback CLI for humans and AI agents

scripts.dev: bun run graphql:generate && bun run src/index.ts
scripts.build: bun run graphql:generate && bun build --compile --minify --outfile dist/rawback src/index.ts
scripts.build:windows-arm64: bun run graphql:generate && bun run scripts/build-windows-arm64.ts
scripts.g: bun run graphql:schema && bun run graphql:generate
scripts.graphql:check: bun run graphql:generate && git check-ignore --quiet src/gql/graphql.ts
scripts.check: bun run graphql:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run build
